source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Αφροδίσιος, Μίσδας, Μακρόβιος, Ουαλεριανός, Λεόντιος, Αντωνίνος οι Μάρτυρες και οι συν αυτοίς εν Σκυθουπόλει (Συρίας) μαρτυρησάντων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and enumerates the company by name, so this is one of six folders. **The corpus holds no Misdas at all** and the namesweep raises nothing for the name, so the display name is the bare name. **He is the only one of the six the page gives no couplet to** and no gloss of his name, which is unusual on this site: it glosses Aphrodite, Macrobius, Leontius and Antoninus and passes over him. Nothing is said of him apart from the company and the manner of the death. No year, no emperor, no hymn, no relic.
